name: fix82_autosave
verifies: fix-82 + fix-107: the load list starts with the one quicksave (G3: its QuickSave file sorts first), then the port's one autosave ('Autosave' / 'Автосохранение'), numbered saves after them newest first; the save list shows neither (its first line is 'New Savegame', Enter there writes a numbered save); F5 always writes 'quick' and F9 loads it, the autosave always writes 'auto' (fix-107 [owner]: no two-file rotation, no '(latest)' mark); a row's second line is the game time and the place the hero saved at; fix-112: the files page shows seven bigger rows, the quicksave and the autosave share the first line (Right/Left move between the halves, Down to the numbered saves, Up back to the half last used), Del does not delete the autosave; the autosave is written through the same save system, refused while saving is blocked (knock-out), written by its timer only when saving is allowed (a due autosave waits out the block), an autosave restarts its interval, the player's own saves (quick, menu) do not (fix-112 [owner])
